english:
Luke 4:35. And he said to them: to verse 40. they obeyed him.

In the Evening
Mesedi of the Nativity. Proclamation: Mother of Holiness. Hymn at the Dismissal [Hambartsi], Tone 4 [dts]: New Sion bringing forth. Proclamation: The Holy Mother of God. Live [Këtso]. Prayer: Receive, Lord.

Monday
Of the Saints: Stephen of Ulne, and the witnesses Goharinos, Tsamidos, Tychicus, and Radicos. Canticle of the Fathers for Martyrs. Processional [Mankunk], Tone 4 [dts]: Today she rejoices. Hymn at the Dismissal [Hambartsi], Tone 4 [dk]: Martyr and witness of Christ. Midday Hymn: Of Martyrs. Psalm 115:15 [116:15]: Precious is. Proverbs 10:1: A wise son, to verse 7: of the wicked shall be quenched. Prophet Isaiah 44:24: Thus says the Lord, to verse 26: he justifies. Epistle: Hebrews 4:11: Brethren, let us hasten, to verse 15: without sin. Alleluia: of the martyrs, according to the Tone. Gospel: Matthew 5:1: And seeing the multitudes, to verse 12: which were before you.

Tuesday
Of the Holy Prophets: Ezekiel, Ezra, and Zechariah the father of John the Baptist. Hymn of the Sunrise [Aravotyan Orhnutiun], Tone 1 [ak]: Who the divine, with its proper canon. Magnificat [Metsatsustse], Tone 4 [dts]: Undefiled Virgin. Processional [Mankunk], Tone 4 [dk]: Who beforehand. Midday Hymn: Tone 3 [aj]: Ray of light. Psalm 67:26 [68:26]: In the congregations bless. Prophet Ezekiel 18:30: Thus says the Lord, to verse 32: his soul. Epistle: 1 Corinthians 2:6: We speak wisdom, to verse 10: the deep things of God. Alleluia: In the congregations bless. Gospel: Matthew 23:34: Wherefore, to verse 39: in the name of the Lord. Hymn at the Dismissal [Hambartsi], Tone 3 [gts]: Who beforehand.

Wednesday
Canticle of the Fathers for Repentance. Midday Psalm 64 [65]: Save. Epistle: 2 Corinthians 3:4: Such trust, to verse 17: there is liberty. Alleluia: according to the Tone. Gospel: Mark 6:45: And straightway, to verse 56: they were saved.

Thursday
Of the Saints: John the Forerunner and Job the Righteous. Hymn of the Sunrise [Aravotyan Orhnutiun], Tone 3 [gts]: The prophet of the Highest, with its proper canon. Processional [Mankunk] and Hymn at the Dismissal [Hambartsi], Tone 3 [gk]: Superior among the prophets. Midday Psalm 98 [99]: God is glorified; response [Pokh]: Of mercy. Proverbs 20:6: Great is man, to verse 22: he shall be a helper. Book of Job 42:12: And the Lord blessed, to verse 16: from Abraham. Prophet Jeremiah, Lamentations 3:22: The mercies of the Lord, to verse 56: to my voice (selected reading). Acts 13:25: And as John fulfilled, to verse 33: having raised up Jesus. Catholic Epistle: James 5:7: Be patient, to verse 11: and merciful. Alleluia: And you, child. Gospel: Matthew 11:1: At that time, to verse 12: they told Jesus.

Friday
Canticle of the Fathers for Rest. Midday Psalm 97 [98]: All have seen. Epistle: 2 Corinthians 5:6: Therefore we are always confident, to verse 18: of reconciliation. Alleluia: according to the Tone. Gospel: Mark 7:24: And from thence he arose, to verse 30: on the bed.

Saturday
Of the Holy Council of Nicaea: the three hundred and eighteen patriarchs. Hymn of the Sunrise [Aravotyan Orhnutiun], Tone 4 [dk]: Today the holy patriarchs, with its proper canon. Processional [Mankunk], Tone 3 [gts]: O wondrous; followed by: In the Holy Trinity. Midday Entrance [Zhamamut]: The patriarchal. Hymn, Tone 3 [gts]: Today the heavenly ones. Psalm: Thy priests. Prophet Ezekiel 44:23: Thus says the Lord to the priests, to verse 24: they shall keep my feasts. Epistle: Hebrews 12:1: Wherefore seeing we also, to verse 7: God dealeth with you. Alleluia: Thy priests. Gospel: John 14:25: These things have I spoken unto you, to verse 31: let us go hence.

Understand, O lover of feasts, if the interval of eating meat is three weeks, these are the feasts that are set down up to this point. And the fourth Sunday becomes the Eve of the Fast of the Holy Cross; at that time, the feasts set down below are celebrated in another place. But if the meat-eating period is four weeks, add one week here, in which the feasts set down below are celebrated, and the fifth Sunday becomes the Eve of the Fast. And in such years, sometimes the Apostles James and Simon, being separated from Thomas, are celebrated on the Saturday of this week. The Directory [Tarekirk] shows you all this.

Fourth Sunday after the Holy Mother of God. Song of the Resurrection. Midday Psalm 64 [65]: Praise is due to Thee.
